name: Solenne Neuralcrest Lattice Crown
description:
An architectural neural-port fascinator rebuilt as a full crown piece — Solenne's answer to criticism that their earlier port cover was too subtle for Spire event wear. The Lattice Crown is constructed from hand-bent gold-titanium wire in an open lattice structure that frames the skull without touching it, anchored by a slim internal headband of ivory synth-suede. Micro-filament bioluminescent threads are woven through the lattice, pulsing in slow waves synchronized to the wearer's BCI heartbeat data.

Designed to display — not conceal — cranial chrome and neural port hardware as deliberate aesthetic centerpieces. Custom-fitted per client.
functionality: BCI-synchronized bioluminescent pulse display; structural lattice keeps all elements elevated from scalp to prevent interference with port hardware; custom-fitted to client's specific cranial chrome layout; headband includes inductive charge pad for continuous filament power.
what_it_says: Your augmentation is not something you hide — it is the most expensive thing in the room.
story_hooks: A Lattice Crown commissioned for a Helix Corp board director was intercepted in transit — the BCI sync module contains a passive data-skimming exploit.
One crown's bioluminescent pulse pattern has been quietly encoding the wearer's real-time emotional state, readable by anyone with the right decryption key.
A Solenne atelier artisan is selling unauthorized duplicate fittings — meaning someone has a precise map of a Spire client's cranial hardware layout.

physical_description.visual_profile: An open-frame architectural crown that hovers above the skull like a halo of golden wire. The lattice structure creates an intricate geometric pattern that frames rather than encloses the head, drawing the eye to any visible neural ports or cranial augmentation. Delicate bioluminescent threads trace through the wireframe, creating an ethereal glow. The piece reads as haute couture statement jewelry—aggressive in its refusal to hide augmentation, elegant in execution.
physical_description.fit: Custom-fitted internal headband sits snugly against the crown without contact pressure. The open lattice floats approximately 2-3cm above the scalp, allowing full visibility of neural ports and hardware. Lightweight enough for extended wear at high-status events.
physical_description.primary_material: Hand-bent gold-titanium wire (aerospace-grade, corrosion-resistant), ivory synth-suede internal headband, micro-filament bioluminescent polymer threads
physical_description.texture: Smooth, polished metal with subtle hand-tooling marks visible under close inspection. Threads have a soft, almost fabric-like quality when touched, warm to the skin where the headband makes contact.
physical_description.color_scheme: Rich champagne gold with ivory suede interior. Bioluminescent threads pulse in slow cyan-blue waves, shifting to pale violet at peaks. Highlights reflect harsh white under spotlight conditions.
physical_description.closures: Internal friction-fit headband with micro-adjustment padding. No visible fasteners—engineering is concealed within the suede band.
distinctive_features: Synchronized bioluminescent pulse matching wearer's BCI heartbeat data
Open lattice design deliberately frames cranial augmentation rather than concealing it
Hand-bent gold-titanium wire construction—no two pieces identical
Micro-filament threads woven through lattice create depth and movement
Solenne Atelier maker's mark etched into interior band
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—priced for high-net-worth individuals and corporate elite. The materials and custom fabrication position it as aspirational wear for the Spire set.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals confidence in augmentation status and corpo-adjacent wealth. Worn by those who view neural ports as aesthetic achievement rather than functional necessity. Statement piece for high-stakes social events, gallery openings, executive functions. Deliberately challenges taboos around visible cybernetics.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. Solenne pieces are maintained obsessively by their owners. Bioluminescent threads may develop minor drift over years of use, but this is considered part of the piece's narrative rather than degradation.
